description: Catalog of composable UI patterns for the page-builder agent. Each pattern is a higher-order component built from shadcn/ui primitives and lives in src/components/patterns/<name>/.

patterns.name: data-table-advanced
patterns.purpose: Rich tabular data display with column sort, text filter, row selection and bulk actions.
whenToUse: User management, billing history, audit logs
Any list where users need to filter, sort, or act on multiple items at once

props.columns: Array<{ key: string; header: string; sortable?: boolean; render?: (row) => ReactNode }>
props.bulkActions: Array<{ label: string; onClick: (selectedIds: string[]) => void }>

patterns.name: kanban-board
patterns.purpose: Column-based card board with HTML5 drag-and-drop between columns.
whenToUse: Task trackers, CRM pipelines, content workflow
Any status-based grouping where items move between stages

props.cards: Array<{ id: string; columnId: string; title: string; subtitle?: string; tags?: string[] }>

patterns.name: timeline
patterns.purpose: Vertical time-ordered event stream with icons, titles, timestamps, and descriptions.
whenToUse: Activity feeds, audit trails, order status history

props.items: Array<{ id: string; title: string; description?: string; timestamp: string|Date; icon?: ReactNode; variant?: 'default'|'success'|'warning'|'error' }>

patterns.name: file-manager
patterns.purpose: Grid/list browser for files with upload zone, type icons, size/date, and row actions.
whenToUse: Document management, asset libraries, user uploads
Any product where users store/browse files

props.files: Array<{ id: string; name: string; size: number; type: string; updatedAt: string|Date; url?: string }>

patterns.name: metric-dashboard
patterns.purpose: Grid of KPI cards with value, delta, and inline sparkline trend.
whenToUse: Analytics overview, admin dashboards, executive summary views
Any page where 3-8 headline metrics summarize performance

props.metrics: Array<{ id: string; label: string; value: string|number; delta?: number; deltaLabel?: string; series: number[] }>

patterns.name: comparison-view
patterns.purpose: Side-by-side feature comparison table across 2-5 options/plans/competitors.
whenToUse: Pricing pages, plan upgrade flows, vendor comparison

props.columns: Array<{ id: string; title: string; subtitle?: string; highlighted?: boolean; ctaLabel?: string; onCta?: () => void }>
props.rows: Array<{ feature: string; values: Record<string, boolean|string|number> }>

patterns.name: wizard
patterns.purpose: Multi-step form with progress indicator, per-step validation, and next/back navigation.
whenToUse: Onboarding, checkout, complex settings with 3+ logical groupings
Any form where completion rate improves by chunking

props.steps: Array<{ id: string; title: string; description?: string; content: ReactNode; validate?: () => boolean|Promise<boolean> }>
